program.name: Maintain production ratio 5:1:2
program.source: let offset=0; function step(ctx) { const page=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,offset:offset,limit:32}); const swarms=page.filter(b=>b.shortType===0); const changed=swarms.filter(b=>b.production[0]!==5 || b.production[1]!==1 || b.production[2]!==2); offset=page.length===32?offset+32:0; return {output:{tick:ctx.tick,checkedSwarms:swarms.length,correctionsQueued:changed.length},orders:changed.map(b=>({type:'production',building:{id:b.id,generation:b.generation},ratios:[5,1,2]}))}; }

program.name: Sixteen workers, then warriors
program.source: let finished=false; let requested=false; let offset=0; let counted=0; function step(ctx){if(finished)return {}; const swarm=ctx.game.building({id:0,generation:1}); if(!swarm){finished=true;ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-swarm-missing',reason:'The watched swarm is no longer available; the workforce order cannot be completed.',data:{tick:ctx.tick}});return {output:{status:'swarm unavailable'}};} if(requested){if(swarm.production[0]===0 && swarm.production[1]===0 && swarm.production[2]>0){finished=true;ctx.wakeAgent({key:'sixteen-workers-warriors-confirmed',reason:'The worker threshold was reached and the swarm is now confirmed to produce only warriors.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,workersAtThreshold:counted,production:swarm.production}});return {output:{status:'confirmed; monitoring ended'}};}return {output:{status:'awaiting confirmation'}};} const page=ctx.game.units({team:ctx.myTeam,offset:offset,limit:200});counted+=page.filter(u=>u.type===0).length;if(counted>=16){if(offset>0){offset=0;counted=0;const all=ctx.game.units({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:32768});counted=all.filter(u=>u.type===0).length;if(counted<16)return {output:{workers:counted}};}requested=true;return {output:{status:'warrior-only production ordered',workers:counted},orders:[{type:'production',building:{id:swarm.id,generation:swarm.generation},ratios:[0,0,1]}]};}if(page.length===200){offset+=200;}else{const workers=counted;offset=0;counted=0;return {output:{workers:workers,status:'watching'}};}return {output:{status:'counting'}};}

program.name: Workforce threshold: inn priority
program.source: let phase='watch';let orderedTick=0;const innRef={id:1,generation:1};function step(ctx){if(phase==='done')return {};if(phase==='verify'){const inn=ctx.game.building(innRef);if(inn&&inn.priority===1){phase='done';ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-inn-complete',reason:'The workforce passed fifteen workers and the inn is confirmed at high priority.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,inn:innRef}});return {output:{status:'confirmed'}};}if(ctx.tick-orderedTick>=100){phase='done';ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-inn-unconfirmed',reason:'The workforce threshold was reached, but the inn priority change could not be confirmed.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,innPresent:inn!==null}});}return {};}const units=ctx.game.units({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200});const workers=units.filter(u=>u.type===0).length;if(workers<=15)return {output:{observedWorkers:workers}};const inn=ctx.game.building(innRef);if(!inn){phase='done';ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-inn-missing',reason:'The workforce passed fifteen workers, but the designated inn no longer exists.',data:{workers,tick:ctx.tick}});return {};}if(inn.priority===1){phase='done';ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-inn-complete',reason:'The workforce passed fifteen workers; the inn is already confirmed at high priority.',data:{workers,tick:ctx.tick}});return {};}phase='verify';orderedTick=ctx.tick;return {output:{workers,status:'priority ordered'},orders:[{type:'priority',building:innRef,priority:1}]};}
